about.description: FaidaBiz is a smart business notebook designed for small and medium traders. Record your sales, track expenses, manage products and stock, monitor debts, and see your profit — all from your phone, anytime, anywhere. No accounting knowledge required.
about.features_title: What FaidaBiz can do for you
about.feat_sales_body: Log every sale with one or more products, view daily sales history, and track your profit in real time.
about.feat_expenses_body: Record all business expenses — rent, electricity, transport, and more — so you always know where your money goes.
about.feat_purchases_body: Log stock purchases from suppliers and know the true cost of your goods at all times.
about.feat_products_body: Maintain a full product catalogue with buying price, selling price, and live stock levels with low-stock alerts.
about.feat_debts_body: Record customers who buy on credit and track their repayments so no debt is ever forgotten.
about.feat_reports_body: Get detailed reports on sales, expenses, purchases and profit — filter by day, week or any custom period.
about.feat_team_body: Add cashiers or managers to your shop. Each staff member logs in with their own account so records are traceable.
about.feat_multi_body: Manage several shops or branches from one phone. Switch between businesses with a single tap.
about.feat_referral_body: Invite fellow traders to FaidaBiz. When they subscribe, you earn a cash bonus paid directly to your mobile money.
about.feat_subscription_body: Pay once a year, twice a year, or quarterly. No hidden fees — one transparent price.
about.feat_chat_body: Get direct help through the in-app chat. The FaidaBiz support team is ready to assist you.
about.contact: For more help, call +255799305441 or use the in-app chat.

manual.title: User manual
manual.settings_tile_hint: Learn how to use every FaidaBiz feature
manual.intro: Read these guides for each home menu so you can use FaidaBiz on your own. Every page has a back arrow at the top left.
manual.sales_body: Record a sale when you sell. Search a product; if missing tap +. Enter quantity and price, then save. Open a sale to view, edit or delete (with a reason).
manual.debts_body: Record a customer buying on credit. Record payments, add more debt, edit details, or delete with a reason and password.
manual.expenses_body: Record business expenses. Open a record to view history, edit, or delete with a reason.
manual.products_body: Register products, unit, stock, buying and selling prices. Open a product to edit or delete.
manual.purchases_body: Record stock purchases. If the product is missing, tap + to add it. Enter quantity, buying price and selling price. You can view, edit or delete purchases.
manual.reports_body: See summaries of sales, purchases, expenses and profit for a period.
manual.settings_body: Change language, businesses, staff, payments, and read this manual.
manual.subscription_body: Check subscription status, pay, and invite friends for a bonus.
manual.delete_body: Every delete opens a full page (not a popup). You must enter a reason and your password.

delete.soft_hint: This does not permanently erase the record. Status becomes deleted, and you must enter a reason and your password.
delete.reason_required: Enter a delete reason (at least 3 characters).
